Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — ClearStream is excited to move forward. Attached are our first-pass redlines to your standard MSA (see ClearStream_MSA_v1_redlines.docx) and a draft order form / SOW spreadsheet. The questions we've flagged so far:

Thanks,

Thanks — I pulled a first pass on the redlines this afternoon. High-level flags so the intake call is efficient:

- Liability cap: ClearStream proposed unlimited liability for IP and certain types of damages. We'll propose a carve to consequential damages and keep the aggregate cap tied to annual fees.
- Data processing & residency: we can offer an EU-only residency commitment for EU-scope customers, but need product confirmation on export/backups timing (David, can you confirm retention/replication windows?).
- Termination for convenience: proposing 30 days notice + pro rata refund for unused reserved capacity — want to confirm standard therapy here with revenue team.
- IP/Use of outputs: ClearStream asked for broader ownership language on outputs; we'll propose a license-back model with customer ownership where required.

I'll upload a redline with comments into the shared folder before our call. If anyone expects aggressive commercial concessions (discounts, custom SLA), flag them now so I can align with revenue.

-Kimberly
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
